blocking_gap.detail: A deterministic fail-closed binding helper and self-test now exist in the sandbox candidate, but the canonical queue worker/executor still do not invoke programacion.fn_lf_router_input_governance_resolve_v1 nor carry the bound receipt into the exact runtime request. The historical Product Director request also lacks an exact screen subject, so it cannot be reused as current Input Governance authority.
required_resolution: require an exact active screen_code/pantalla subject in each behavioral runtime request when the selected adapter requires Input Governance
invoke the live Router Input Governance resolver with exact adapter metadata and consumer/profile
bind the returned LIVE_CURRENT PASS receipt to request_id/profile_code/input_sha256/source_snapshot_sha256

preserve canonical execution receipt plus raw output, deterministic validation, semantic judge and fresh holdout/adversarial evidence
